review_summary:
**Triage Summary:**

Twenty findings across OpenSSL (libcrypto3/libssl3), Go runtime, and stdlib are all patched and pose minimal active exploitation risk (no KEV entries, EPSS ≤0.487). The OpenSSL cluster (9 CVEs affecting both libcrypto3 and libssl3 3.5.1-r0) represents duplicate findings on the same package version; CVE-2025-15467 carries the highest EPSS (0.487) but remains below critical threshold. One CRITICAL-rated CVE-2025-68121 in Go 1.23.12 has extremely low EPSS (0.008), suggesting severity rating may be conservative or exploit complexity is high.

**Recommended Action:** Approve the build with a scheduled patch deployment within 30 days. Prioritize updating OpenSSL to the patched version and Go to 1.23.13+ to close the CVE-2025-15467 and CVE-2025-68121 vectors, but this is not a blocking issue given the low exploitation probability and availability of fixes.
